import numpy as np
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=250)
L, H, hd = 4, 6, 64
sl = lambda l, j: slice(hd*j, hd*(j+1))

print("n_keys =", len(W))

print("\n== Frobenius norms of main matrices ==")
for l in range(L):
    print("L%d:" % l, " ".join("%s=%.1f" % (n_, np.linalg.norm(W["%s.%d" % (n_, l)]))
          for n_ in ("W_q", "W_k", "W_v", "W_o", "W_fc", "W_proj")))
    g, b = W["ln1_w.%d" % l], W["ln1_b.%d" % l]
    g2, b2 = W["ln2_w.%d" % l], W["ln2_b.%d" % l]
    print("   ln1: rms|w-1|=%.3f max=%.2f ||b||=%.2f | ln2: rms|w-1|=%.3f max=%.2f ||b||=%.2f"
          % (np.sqrt(((g-1)**2).mean()), np.abs(g-1).max(), np.linalg.norm(b),
             np.sqrt(((g2-1)**2).mean()), np.abs(g2-1).max(), np.linalg.norm(b2)))

print("\n== ln |w-1| mean per head-block (dims 64j..64j+63) ==")
for l in range(L):
    g = np.abs(W["ln1_w.%d" % l] - 1); g2 = np.abs(W["ln2_w.%d" % l] - 1)
    print("L%d ln1:" % l, " ".join("%.3f" % g[sl(l, j)].mean() for j in range(H)),
          "  ln2:", " ".join("%.3f" % g2[sl(l, j)].mean() for j in range(H)))

print("\n== per-head QK quadratic form: sym(Q^T K)/8 eigen analysis ==")
print("head |  nQ    nK    nV    nO  |  lam1  lam2  lam3  lam4  lamN1  lamN2 | posRatio k90 | aSyn")
res = {}
for l in range(L):
    for j in range(H):
        s = sl(l, j)
        Q, K_, Vv, O = (W["W_q.%d" % l][s], W["W_k.%d" % l][s],
                        W["W_v.%d" % l][s], W["W_o.%d" % l][:, s])
        A = Q.T @ K_ / 8.0
        S = (A + A.T) / 2
        lam = np.linalg.eigvalsh(S)[::-1]
        p, n = lam[lam > 0].sum(), -lam[lam < 0].sum()
        posr = p / (p + n + 1e-12)
        aa = np.abs(lam)[::-1]
        k90 = int(np.searchsorted(np.cumsum(aa) / aa.sum(), 0.90) + 1)
        nasy = np.linalg.norm(A - S) / (np.linalg.norm(S) + 1e-12)
        res[(l, j)] = dict(Q=Q, K=K_, V=Vv, O=O, A=A, S=S, lam=lam)
        print("L%dH%d |%5.1f %5.1f %5.1f %5.1f | %6.2f %6.2f %6.2f %6.2f %6.2f %6.2f |  %4.2f %4d | %.2f"
              % (l, j, np.linalg.norm(Q), np.linalg.norm(K_), np.linalg.norm(Vv), np.linalg.norm(O),
                 lam[0], lam[1], lam[2], lam[3], lam[-1], lam[-2], posr, k90, nasy))

print("\n== per-head OV spectrum (O_j @ V_j) ==")
print("head |  s1    s2    s3    s4    s5    s6  | evr90  evr95  nOV")
for l in range(L):
    for j in range(H):
        OV = res[(l, j)]["O"] @ res[(l, j)]["V"]
        res[(l, j)]["OV"] = OV
        sv = np.linalg.svd(OV, compute_uv=False)
        p = sv**2 / (sv**2).sum()
        e90 = int(np.searchsorted(np.cumsum(p), 0.90) + 1)
        e95 = int(np.searchsorted(np.cumsum(p), 0.95) + 1)
        print("L%dH%d | %5.2f %5.2f %5.2f %5.2f %5.2f %5.2f | %4d %5d %6.1f"
              % (l, j, sv[0], sv[1], sv[2], sv[3], sv[4], sv[5], e90, e95, np.linalg.norm(OV)))

print("\n== K/Q-composition: ||Rb @ OV_j||F / (||Rb||F * ||OV_j||F) ==")
for l in range(3):
    for mode in ("K", "Q"):
        M = np.zeros((H, H))
        for j in range(H):
            OVj = res[(l, j)]["OV"]; noj = np.linalg.norm(OVj) + 1e-12
            for b in range(H):
                Rb = res[(l + 1, b)][mode]
                M[b, j] = np.linalg.norm(Rb @ OVj) / (np.linalg.norm(Rb) * noj)
        print("[%s-comp L%d->L%d] rows=dst head, cols=src head" % (mode, l, l+1))
        for b in range(H):
            print("  dst H%d: " % b + " ".join("%.2f" % x for x in M[b]))

print("\n== MLP read of head writes: ||W_fc.(l+1) row-block? skip; overall ||W_fc.(l+1)@OV_j||/(norms) ==")
for l in range(3):
    F = W["W_fc.%d" % l + 1] if False else W["W_fc.%d" % (l+1)]
    print("L%d->L%d W_fc: " % (l, l+1), end="")
    for j in range(H):
        OVj = res[(l, j)]["OV"]
        print("%.2f" % (np.linalg.norm(F @ OVj) / (np.linalg.norm(F) * np.linalg.norm(OVj))), end=" ")
    print()

print("\n== rank diagnostics of big matrices ==")
for l in range(L):
    for n_ in ("W_fc", "W_proj"):
        F = W["%s.%d" % (n_, l)]
        sv = np.linalg.svd(F, compute_uv=False)
        p = np.cumsum(sv**2) / (sv**2).sum()
        r99 = int(np.searchsorted(p, 0.99) + 1)
        print("%s.%d: s1=%.1f s2=%.1f s10=%.1f s50=%.1f r99=%d/%d" % (n_, l, sv[0], sv[1], sv[9], sv[49], r99, min(F.shape)))

St0 = np.vstack([W["W_q.0"], W["W_k.0"], W["W_v.0"], W["W_fc.0"]])
sv = np.linalg.svd(St0, compute_uv=False)
p = np.cumsum(sv**2) / (sv**2).sum()
print("\nstacked L0 readers [q;k;v;fc] shape", St0.shape)
print("sv[:20]:", np.round(sv[:20], 2))
print("r90=%d r95=%d r99=%d (max possible 28+128=156)" % (int(np.searchsorted(p, .90)+1), int(np.searchsorted(p, .95)+1), int(np.searchsorted(p, .99)+1)))
